example.content:
let tickCount = 0;
const created = eda.sys_Timer.setIntervalTimer('嘉立创示例_循环', 200, () => { tickCount++; });

await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
const ticksAtClear = tickCount;

_source.title: 设置循环定时器
_source.remarks.text.0: 如果遇到 ID 重复的定时器，则之前设置的定时器将被清除
_source.example.text.0: 1. 设置每 200ms 触发一次的循环定时器，统计触发次数
_source.example.text.2: 3. 用完清除，定时器停止（净零收尾，可重复运行）
_source.example.text.3: 4. 再等一会，确认清除后没有继续触发
_source.params.id: 定时器 ID，用于定位&删除定时器
_source.params.args: 传给定时调用函数的参数

title: Set an interval timer
remarks.text.0: If a timer with a duplicate ID is encountered, the previously set timer will be cleared
params.id: Timer ID, used to locate and delete the timer
params.args: Arguments passed to the timer callback function
returns: Whether the timer was set successfully
